# United Rentals

> > United Rentals is the world's largest equipment rental company, providing construction equipment, tools, and specialized solutions across North America and through regional brands in Australia and New Zealand.

United Rentals operates through multiple brands including Orange Hire, Shore Hire, and Royal Wolf, offering comprehensive equipment rental services ranging from earthmoving and construction equipment to shoring solutions, storage containers, and worksite facilities. The company serves contractors, industrial customers, and municipalities with a vast fleet of rental equipment and tools.
